verificationSummary: Editor commit a42409a31cb855331e5114a52bc3d07d75cb67e6 hardens the bounded visible text-block editing UX. textBlockInlineDraftAdapter normalizes textarea CR/LF into Core document v4 line-break inline atomics before text-block.rich-inline.replace, reconstructs multiline textarea text from text and line-break inline children, and preserves trailing field-ref children outside the editable range. useActiveTextBlockEditing now compares normalized draft children to the Backend source value so a dirty draft returns to the Backend value as clean and Save-disabled. activeTextBlockIsland clears a rejected save state after the next user edit. PaperTextBlockEditor reports bounded dirty/pending/status state and computes rows from hard line breaks plus a soft-wrap estimate without rendering contenteditable. The live browser smoke starts real Editor and Backend loopback servers, types Visible text block editor with three additional hard lines by browser text insertion, saves through text-block.rich-inline.replace, reloads from Backend api transport, reconstructs the multiline value, records textareaRowsAfterTyping 4 and textareaRowsAfterReload 4, verifies contentEditableCount 0, and still reorders afterward. RED evidence included npm run test -- src/tests/activeTextBlockEditingHook.test.ts src/tests/activeTextBlockIsland.test.ts src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts src/tests/editorBrowserLiveBackendSmokeEvidence.test.ts failing for missing dirty cleanup, save rejection recovery, multiline rows/status, and stale live fixture expectations, plus npm run test -- src/tests/textBlockInlineDraftAdapter.test.ts failing because raw CR/LF remained in a text inline child before line-break atomic normalization. Focused GREEN evidence passed npm run test -- src/tests/textBlockInlineDraftAdapter.test.ts src/tests/activeTextBlockEditingHook.test.ts src/tests/activeTextBlockIsland.test.ts src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts src/tests/editorBrowserLiveBackendSmokeEvidence.test.ts with 5 files and 18 tests. Editor worktree npm run type-check, npm run check, and direct live smoke passed; merged Editor main passed the same focused 5-file/18-test gate, npm run check with 102 test files and 354 tests plus build, and FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke. This evidence does not enable WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, field-chip editing, arbitrary rich-inline authoring beyond the contiguous editable text/line-break range beginning at the first text run, table/media/columns text authoring, document v4 insert semantics, generic node add paths, durable draft persistence, collaboration, large-document authoring performance readiness, accessibility readiness, exact layout readiness, export parity, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, broad corpus coverage, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth.
